svg.title: C18-M04-F1: Where personal data lives in an AI application
svg.desc: Training data, retrieval index, conversation logs and vendor storage with their main control needs.
svg.text: C18-M04-F1 Where personal data lives in an AI application
training/fine-tuning data -> model weights (no per-user ACL, hard to delete)
source documents -> retrieval index (needs ACLs, deletion sync)
user prompts + outputs -> conversation logs, analytics (retention, access)
prompts sent to vendor -> vendor storage (terms, location, training use)
Figure C18-M04-F1. Four data stores, four sets of controls.
